name: v2 · W9 - Approval gate and evidence

parameters.content:
## W9 Approval gate and evidence
Top lane: the one gate for every decision. A decision needs a name, a rejection or override needs a reason, and a broken chain refuses everything. Each decision is hash-chained into the ledger; a racing write is removed and gets a 409, never an overwrite. Bottom lane: the feed the platform page reads.

**Trigger:** POST /webhook/terracorridor-v2/decide; GET /webhook/terracorridor-v2/platform
**Reads:** corridor_class, corridor_obligations, corridor_findings, corridor_ledger
**Writes:** corridor_ledger
**Next:** web/platform.html

Every POST needs the header named in the "TerraCorridor v2 webhook key" credential (Header Auth). The platform page sends it when opened with ?key=. The GET feed is open: it serves public-data assessments only.

Part of the v2 set. Hackathon originals are untouched. Source of truth: github.com/katiescase/terracorridor, scripts/make-platform-workflows.js. Change the repo and re-import, do not hand-edit.
